REPO=Path('/scratch/cluster/mrudolph/documents/air-hockey-rl')
WEIGHTS={'online': '01e1548f1bb0163bf672f39d15e132f5a5697e2319b484dbb5fced8a6b982305', 'target': '7fb377f4dc7da0c8dd1a7fb6f822ccd81d3e763d5e2bb14c6cddfa4143439b5d'}
REVIEWED={'airhockey/airhockey_base.py': 'a3a8c1c37fdb53015b6cb2568b1b9ccc39e6f6dff39323a4c25f97ae88fcb4d6', 'airhockey/sims/airhockey_box2d.py': '7059de3e1f8a979c706eb2546ba7674c4970226952bc002567a1d2aa20fa7eee', 'configs/new_juggle/sysid_v2_hist2.yaml': '5005076245b4ba9e6d95c1d9efa337b59e57a24017e117db97b45644758f5349', 'configs/new_juggle/sustained/original_sensing.yaml': 'd1bb13a7a4a5494507d085db230bdbe31854f0ddb556ccf88c3ec5aca0360385', 'scripts/rma/history.py': 'd7c3456d01c8e612c28ffb560d3711722a17948e002be313de0c54e9c0576f94', 'scripts/rma/evaluate.py': '24cb367940072b483b97d0fee9bb6ddd722b0a27424f5197e2634337b241570f', 'scripts/td3/juggle_survival.py': 'e533f1f3b0dd34bcdfeef6e5dec10922422edde5a16db8cff706736d832b8a92', 'scripts/analysis/juggle_motion_metrics.py': '3c36447afa2dc0f99b72c06c134411d853c89d06004fb4fdc5296e5006ef7f67', 'scripts/td3/helper/juggle_counter.py': 'c87916662f35ff091cf0a4be47bdef90d0be92a8a9917f66632807e01a7f40cc'}
def save(status,**details):
    (ROOT/'status.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(status=status,updated_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),**details),indent=2)+chr(10))
try:
    for role in ['online','target']:
        for name, expected in REVIEWED.items():
            assert hashlib.sha256((REPO/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected, name
        bundle=ROOT/('frozen_'+role)
        assert hashlib.sha256((bundle/'model.pth').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==WEIGHTS[role]
        save('evaluating',role=role)
        cmd=[str(REPO/'.venv/bin/python'),'-u','-m','scripts.td3.juggle_survival','--run-dir',str(bundle),'--scenario-set','training','--episodes','32','--horizon','20000','--seed-base','700000','--gif-steps','0','--out-dir',str(ROOT/('paired_'+role+'_20k_eval'))]
        subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=REPO,check=True)
        assert hashlib.sha256((bundle/'model.pth').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==WEIGHTS[role]
        subprocess.run([cmd[0],'-m','scripts.analysis.juggle_motion_metrics','--results',str(ROOT/('paired_'+role+'_20k_eval')/'results.json')],cwd=REPO,check=True)
    save('complete')
except Exception as exc:
    save('failed',error=repr(exc))
    raise
